sn6.7:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena Bhagavā divāvihāragato hoti paṭisallīno || || 3.
sn6.7:1.3: Atha kho Subrahmā ca paccekabrahmā Suddhāvāso ca paccekabrahmā yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkamiṃsu || upasaṅkamitvā paccekadvārabāhaṃ nissāya aṭṭhaṃsu || || 4.
sn6.7:1.4: Atha kho Subrahmā paccekabrahmā kokālikaṃ bhikkhum ārabbha Bhagavato santike imaṃ gātham abhāsi || ||
